faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for I&FC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in I&FC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 28 vacancies: 24 Assistant Engineer (Civil)/Assistant Surveyor of Works (Civil), 4 Assistant Engineer (Mech.)/Assistant Surveyor of Works (Mech.).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for I&FC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Proforma attached to the notice (page 3)) and send it to Deputy Secretary (GAD Flood), Office of the Addl. Chief Secretary, Irrigation & Flood Control Department, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, L.M. Bund Office Complex, Shastri Nagar, Delhi-110031, by through proper channel, to reach by 27 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Level-07 for Assistant Engineer (Civil)/Assistant Surveyor of Works (Civil), Pay Level-07 for Assistant Engineer (Mech.)/Assistant Surveyor of Works (Mech.).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Central/State Govt officers holding analogous posts, or serving in Pay Level-6 (Rs.35400-112400) with qualifying service: Civil 3 years (degree) / 7 years (diploma) as Junior Engineer or equivalent; Mech. 4/8 years (degree/diploma) plus a degree/diploma in Mechanical/Elect. Engg. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officers under the Central/State Government can apply, on Transfer on Deputation basis.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assistant Engineer (Mech.): departmental officers in the feeder category in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for deputation. Officers whose age exceeds 56 years on the closing date.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Transfer on Deputation initially for one year, extendable as per DoP&T, GoI instructions depending on the deputationist's performance. Period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years.
